title: What monthly photovoltaic summaries can identify about sensors and missing days
abstract: We audit eight monthly summaries from a rooftop photovoltaic system. The May and June implied capacity intervals are disjoint under common averaging, even after rounding. Two explicit daily records reproduce generation, theoretical yield, irradiation and performance ratio at the reported precision. One retains all dates and includes a June irradiation offset, and the other omits one irradiation reading. The May data also impose a sharp covariance constraint if performance ratio denotes a mean of daily ratios. We give the complete synthetic daily witnesses and distinguish them from measurements of the plant.
